title: Best Concatenation
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2 \leq N \leq 2 \times 10^5; N is an integer.; S_i is a string of length at least 1 consisting of digits from 1 through 9 and the character X.; The sum of lengths of S_1, S_2, \ldots, S_N is at most 2 \times 10^5.
